name: agent-tasks
description: Orchestrates several AI coding agents from one AGENT TASKS panel: runs of dependency-ordered tasks, each worked by a supervised agent in its own worktree and tmux session, with a coordinator inbox and decision gates. Workers report back through the agent-task CLI and the app's agent hooks, and are tracked by tmux pane id while no browser is open.

agentTasks.worktreeLocation.description: Where a worker started with a new worktree gets its checkout. {repo} is the repository root and {branch} the branch made from the task title.

agentTasks.heartbeatTimeoutSeconds.description: How long a worker can go without any sign of life (a heartbeat, a message, a hook event) before its dispatch is marked lost and the task returns to ready. A worker whose pane is gone is marked lost at once, whatever this says.

agentTasks.archiveAfterDays.description: Runs whose tasks have all finished move to the archive this many days after their last activity. Archived runs can be restored from the panel.
